facts.shortSummary: The party reaches the shrine and gets its bearings.
facts.longSummary: The party arrives at the ruined shrine, takes stock of the site, and discusses what to do next before bedding down nearby.

location.notes: The party is settling in here.

npcs.name: Caretaker Nella
npcs.notes: She greets the party at the shrine.

facts.shortSummary: Bandits spring an ambush on the road.
facts.longSummary: As the party departs the shrine the next morning, a bandit crew attacks from cover and forces an immediate roadside fight.

location.context: morning departure along the old road

organizations.name: Ashen Knives
organizations.notes: The bandit crew behind the ambush.
